BiblicalUsage: bena is used for to build, and it appears 19 times across the Bible. The enemies write that the Jews are building the rebellious city, and Nebuchadnezzar boasts of the great Babylon he built.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God builds His house through His people, and that the rebuilding after exile is a picture of what He still does with broken lives. That is why I keep coming back to it: bena is not a word to rush past.
